text.p: ReliaStar Financial Corp and Security-Connecticut Corp said Tuesday Security-Connecticut shareholders voted to approve the merger of Security-Connecticut into ReliaStar.

At a special shareholder meeting in Avon, Connecticut, Security-Connecticut received the required number of affirmative shareholder votes to proceed with the transaction. ReliaStar said that the merger has also been approved by insurance departments in the states of New York and Connecticut.

The Security-Connecticut board also said it declared a special dividend related to the merger. The dividend, $0.67 per share of Security-Connecticut common stock, is payable July 10 to shareholders of record on July 1, or immediately prior to the closing of the merger.
In February, ReliaStar and Security-Connecticut said the companies signed a definitive agreement to merge in a stock-for-stock transaction.

The final exchange ratio is based on the average closing price of ReliaStar common stock during the 20-day trading period preceding the last required approval, which was today's shareholder vote. The average price was $67.64 a share, resulting in a final exchange ratio of 0.7367 share of ReliaStar per Security-Connecticut share.
The two companies said they expect the merger to officially close on July 1.
